request.name: Link or unlink what an invoice bills

description.content: Attach an existing invoice to the pay application, payment-schedule installment and/or bid it bills, or detach it (send `null`). Allowed in every status except `voided`, so an imported, manual or already-paid invoice can be linked after the fact; only the link columns and the derived `sourceType` change — never lines, totals or status — and nothing is pushed to QuickBooks. The pay app must be on the invoice's own project, live (submitted, sent, approved or paid) and not already claimed by another live invoice; the installment must be on the project's bid's payment term and not billed by another live invoice. An invoice bills a pay app or an installment, not both. The response carries the project's billed figures before and after; `dryRun: true` returns them without saving.

Revokes an access token or refresh token. Body MUST be application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Per RFC 7009 §2.2, the response is 200 OK whether the token was successfully revoked, already revoked, expired, or unknown — this prevents leaking information about token validity. Revoking a refresh token cascades to the entire token family (all access + refresh tokens issued from the same grant). Revoking an access token does NOT cascade.
